name: personal-claude-harness
description: 個人用 Claude Code ハーネス。開発用の lint / test スクリプトを保持するためだけの package.json で、配布物ではない。

scripts.lint:repo: npm run lint && npm run lint:unused && npm run lint:architecture
scripts.test:core: node scripts/ci/validate-runtime-surface.js && node scripts/ci/validate-hooks.js && node scripts/ci/validate-commands.js && node scripts/ci/validate-rules.js && node scripts/ci/validate-artifact-templates.js && node scripts/ci/validate-no-personal-paths.js && node scripts/ci/validate-local-config.js && node scripts/ci/audit-harness-contract.js && node scripts/ci/smoke-harness-lifecycle.js && node tests/run-all.js
